title: Old National accused of failing to properly investigate nearly $100K withdrawal
description: The brother of a woman who died last December is suing Indiana’s Old National Bank after he claims it failed to properly investigate the unauthorized, electronic withdrawal of more than $98,000 from his sister’s account.
